This update brings more control over image exports.

- More settings for JPEG sampling, PNG interlacing, WebP presets, palettes and dithering.
- Additional GIF transparency, BMP/TGA colour and TIFF precision options.
- Lossless AVIF and lossless alpha through the updated optional codec pack.
- Additional HEIC export options where supported by the selected codec.
- Simpler HEIF handling without the remaining Heifer dependency, alongside updated documentation.

Related to issues 196, 221 and 222.
